data.taskBrief:
TASK BRIEF: Geocode a street address into latitude and longitude for dispatch job-site support (HPE Aruba Networking Orchestrator)

FIT
  Partially. The supplied request geocodes an address, but no supplied requests check payment status or notify technicians. All supplied requests serve the geocoding portion of the task.

AUTH
  API key authentication for step 1
  Header: X-Auth-Token: <apiKey>

BASE URL
  https://172.16.3.20/gms/rest

STEPS
  1. GET /location/addressToLocation
     Params:
       address: string — '1600 Amphitheatre Parkway, Mountain View, CA' (required query parameter)
       Accept: header — '*/*'
     Returns:
       200 OK; an array of matching location objects. Each object may include formatted_address (string), geometry.location.lat and geometry.location.lng (numbers), geometry.bounds, geometry.location_type, geometry.viewport, address_components (array), place_id (string), and types (array). Use the first array element for the best match.
     Threading:
       None

GOTCHAS
  - Replace {{orchestratorBaseUrl}} with https://172.16.3.20/gms/rest; the request path is /location/addressToLocation.
  - The address must be sent in the query string, not in a request body.
  - The collection references {{apiKey}}, but no value for it is supplied; provide the API key in the X-Auth-Token header.
  - The response is an array and may contain multiple matches. For the best match, read geometry.location.lat and geometry.location.lng from the first element.
  - The request does not specify payment-status or technician-notification operations.
